title: Tree stacking equals the Csernák--Soukup estimator on nontrivial finite trees
summary: A Lean 4 proof of the corrected nontrivial-tree form of the Csernák--Soukup tree-stacking conjecture. For every finite tree with at least two vertices, the exact-size stacking number equals the explicit rooted-distance-and-degree estimator. The one-vertex case is excluded because the source stacking-number convention restricts admissible thresholds to t >= 2 while the displayed estimator is 1 on the one-vertex tree.
